extract_policy: Selected literal functions, LF/trailing whitespace normalized. Exact original retained in work folder. No JS execution, login or live mutation.
contracts: POST meeting.url+/agenda/reorder JSON {agenda:[{id,parent_agenda_id}]}; root parent0, preorder recursion through agenda; refetch list
POST meeting.url+/agenda/update multipart: id,text,description,is_private,original_token,people_responsible[],duration,attachments[index][type]=attachment and attachment_id for existing uploads
Boardable.onedrive.access_token is a runtime value. Adapter only supports explicit null runtime token, serialized by FormData as null string; no cloud import.
Explicit X-CSRF-TOKEN=window.csrfToken() and XMLHttpRequest header declared by vendor client.
limits: Legacy editor only. has_agenda_builder or has_approval_workflows selects a separate agenda_app_url; no equivalence inferred.
Application supplies exact Boardable.org_url and meeting.url, session/CSRF and policy. No inferred slugs or credentials.
prepare-draft is a mutation and is never executed by plan/readback.
Only existing sibling reorder and text/description edits; preserve people, duration, privacy, existing attachments and unknown fields.
